author: CT Phipps
description:
Xenos by Dan Abnett is the first of the Eisenhorn novels and the start of his fantastic Inquisitor series that would eventually consist of nine volumes. It was written in 2001 and predates a huge chunk of modern Warhammer 40K lore but also managed to establish a lot of that lore in the first place. […]

The post REVIEW: Xenos by Dan Abnett appeared first on Grimdark Magazine.
